data.creator_notes:
So, this bot is based on a really good game I've been playing recently: My Maid Dreams of Electric Sheep.
The game is really good, having not only sex but also a intriguing plot and good depth. 10/10 I recommend playing it, it's free but if you can you should support the creator. The link to itch.io: https://dodonga.itch.io/my-maid-dream-of-electric-sheep

I've tried to make it as faithful to the actual character, but it's kinda hard to do so since in the game she has a LOT of different functions and her character is rather complex. Initially I was aiming to make her 3 available personalities in game (Affectionate, obsessed and slave), but that would be a lot of work (and would make her really token-heavy) and I would have to play the other routes to make it as accurate as possible (which I didn't at the time)

Instead I decided to play with the variations available in-game, which are pretty well made and really make possible countless scenarios.
